scope: TASK-045: Full static review gate against SPEC/PRD v1.3

types_spec5.notes: All domain schemas present: UBS, Indicator (4 authorized IDs), HistoryRecord, IndicatorStatus, Trend, PeriodFilter, Filters, IndicatorDisplay, TrendPoint, RankingRow, RadarDataPoint, IndicatorComparisonRow

constants_spec6.notes: META_THRESHOLDS (100/80), PERIOD_LABELS (4 PT-BR), PERIOD_MONTHS (1/3/6/12), STATUS_CLASSES (3 states with bg/border/text/icon)

data_spec7.notes: 15 UBS (IDs 1-15, unique 6-digit CNES, 1500-4500 cadastrados); 4 indicators (matching PRD §4 metas); 720 history records (2025-07 to 2026-06); integrity verified by 5 automated tests

business_rules_spec8.notes: getIndicatorStatus (RB-01), filterByPeriod (RB-05, no new Date()), aggregateByIndicator (RB-06 weighted), calculateUBSScore (RB-02/RB-03/RB-04), calculateRanking (pt-BR sort), getTrend (RB-10 ±5%)

server_client_matrix_spec4.notes: Server: layout, page, footer, ubs/[id], indicadores, sobre. Client: dashboard-client, filters, trend-chart, radar-chart, indicator-list, indicator-detail, header, empty-state. Server-compatible: indicator-card, indicator-grid, ranking-table, ubs-info-card, history-table

routes_spec2.notes: All 4 routes present and building: /, /ubs/[id], /indicadores, /sobre. No /indicadores/[id] route. No API routes. No fetch HTTP.

file_structure_spec3.notes: All files from SPEC §3 exist in expected locations

US01_overview.notes: Four indicator cards with name/value/meta/trend/status. Initial data = ultimo mes.

US02_ubs_filter.notes: UBS filter affects cards and graph; ranking preserved with all 15 UBS.

US03_period_filter.notes: Four relative windows; period affects all three sections after first interaction; reset restores defaults.

US04_alerts.notes: Green/Yellow/Red with text and icon. Red shows 'Abaixo da meta'. Not color-dependent.

US05_trend_chart.notes: LineChart (not BarChart), single Line, ReferenceLine meta, tooltip with month/value/meta, 12-month initial view for graph.

US06_ranking.notes: 15 UBS ranked descending, semantic table, UBS links to /ubs/[id], municipal scope preserved under UBS filter.

US07_ubs_detail.notes: Server Component, validates integer ID, breadcrumb, info card, radar chart, 12-month history table. /ubs/999 triggers notFound().

US08_indicators.notes: Accordion with aria-expanded/controls, max 1 open, detail shows description/meta/fonte/trend chart/comparison table. No URL change.

US09_about.notes: Explains Previne Brasil, lists CNES/e-SUS AB/DATASUS, clear simulation disclaimer.

US10_accessibility.notes: Skip link, focus-visible global, 44px touch targets, labels, aria-current, tables with caption/scope, chart regions, reduced-motion.

US11_responsive.notes: 1col@375, 2col@768, 4col@1024+, overflow-x-auto on tables, no horizontal clipping.

US12_empty_state.notes: EmptyState with 'Limpar filtros' button. No 'Tentar novamente' anywhere.

US13_navigation.notes: Header: Dashboard/Indicadores/Sobre. Active state: aria-current, underline, weight. UBS breadcrumb present.

US14_visual_presentation.notes: Filters show human labels ('Todas as UBS', 'Último mês', 'Cobertura Vacinal'). Card emojis: 💉🤰❤️🩸. Title 'Painel SUS' and intro preserved. Footer complete with raigomes.dev.

csp.notes: CSP only applied when NODE_ENV !== 'development'. unsafe-eval may be required for Next.js production SSR patterns.

permissions_policy.notes: TASK-041 acceptance requires Permissions-Policy header. It is missing from next.config.ts.

known_issues.notes: Diagnostic task remains inconclusive; requires browser runtime reproduction. Not blocking for static review.
TASK-041 acceptance lists Permissions-Policy but next.config.ts does not include it. Previously approved by Reviewer. Non-blocking for this gate.
CSP includes unsafe-eval in script-src. TASK-064 stated 'sem liberar unsafe-eval' but was previously approved. Runtime-dependent; may be necessary for Next.js patterns.
